acceptanceCriteria: Prepare a separately reviewable candidate specification for the Chinese twelve-lü content and the Indian śruti content. Each proposal identifies the exact variant, tradition/context, content classification, authoritative sources, ordered pitch data and units, spelling/labels, tonic and reference assumptions, playback mapping, limitations, and disputed interpretations.

Distinguish tuning systems, pitch-reference models, scales/modes, and instrument or performance profiles where applicable; never present a variable or contested tradition as one universal correct tuning.

Present the exact source-qualified candidates and their limits to the user for approval before accepting either candidate as built-in catalog content. Implement only the candidates the user approves, using documented-model or editable-template labeling as appropriate.

For every approved candidate, demonstrate provenance and classification in catalog metadata, deterministic profile-to-frequency resolution with explicit reference assumptions, and tests for the approved data and silent selection/playback behavior.

testSteps: For each candidate, review the cited authoritative sources and record the exact variant, context, mathematical data, units, labels, reference assumptions, and source limitations.
Have the user review and approve or reject each exact candidate specification before adding catalog data.
